headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while the market leader trimmed its outlook.
summary: Coforge delivered the fastest revenue expansion at 53.6% YoY, driven by AI‑centric services. Infosys, the sector's largest player, saw only 1.5% revenue growth and cut its FY27 guidance to 1‑2%. Most peers posted double‑digit growth, but profit margins varied, with HCLTech improving operating margin to 18.2% and Infosys slipping to 21.1%. Dividend payouts remained steady across the board.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting a 29% AI revenue rise and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys lowered FY27 revenue guidance, reflecting slower growth, while HCLTech raised its operating margin outlook.

themes.title: Dividend consistency
themes.detail: Most companies announced or maintained interim dividends, signaling cash‑flow confidence.
